Spacious 4-Bedroom HMO Flat – Gayfield Square, Edinburgh

Situated on the elegant and sought-after Gayfield Square, this spacious four-bedroom basement flat offers ideal accommodation for students or professionals, with a full HMO license in place. Located just a short walk from the heart of Edinburgh's city centre and the vibrant bars, cafes, and shops of Broughton Street, this property combines city living with a peaceful residential setting.

Property Features:

4 generously sized double bedrooms.

Large living room perfect for socialising or relaxing

Fully equipped modern kitchen

Contemporary bathroom with shower over bath, plus an additional shower room for convenience

Private main door access

Gas central heating

Excellent transport links nearby, including bus and tram services

Walking distance to Waverley Station, Princes Street, and Calton Hill

Ideal for students or young professionals, this well-presented flat offers both comfort and convenience in one of Edinburgh’s most desirable central locations.
